svg.title: Sprint capacity: what each person can take, against what they have — SoftTrack web design mockup (#269)
svg.desc: A sprint shows what it holds and the workload tab shows what one person has open, and neither says what a person can take in this sprint. A planning view sets what is assigned against each person’s capacity, reduced when they are away, with unassigned tickets as a row of their own and a suggestion from the last three sprints.
